bio.text: Ryan Peterman, a Democrat, announced in May 2025 that he would run for Iowa secretary of state in 2026, according to Iowa Capital Dispatch.

Iowa Capital Dispatch reported that he grew up in Bettendorf, served 10 years as a Navy helicopter pilot after graduating from the Naval Academy, and later worked at the Naval Academy as an honor education officer.
It also reported that he spent a year as a legislative fellow for U.S. Sen. Jeanne Shaheen.
Ballotpedia lists him as having advanced from the June 2, 2026 Democratic primary for Iowa secretary of state.

sources.title: Democrat Ryan Peterman launches bid for Iowa secretary of state
Paul Pate (Iowa Secretary of State election, 2026 results)
